value: Harold Carr, holding a Ph.D. in Computer Science, is a researcher at Oracle Labs specializing in blockchain consensus protocols, privacy, confidentiality, and scalability. His extensive career encompasses work on cloud infrastructure, InfiniBand transport, and remoting system technologies (REST, SOAP, CORBA, RMI) at Oracle and Sun Microsystems. Earlier, he contributed to distributed Lisp and C++ systems at Hewlett-Packard and Schlumberger Research Laboratories, and served as Chief Architect of Lisp technology at Autodesk, alongside experience in logic simulation consultancy.
